description: Step by step, how to do one thing in Wuai on Windows and Android, with a link to a short video of it.

task.description: captions: make or show captions; translate: captions in another language; later: caption a video in the background to watch later; clip: keep part of a video with its captions; share: send it to an app; post: post to several sites (Windows); save: keep the video or its sound.
